title: Verizon sets $10 monthly fee for iPhone Handoff feature
excerpt: Verizon is introducing a $10 monthly charge for the iPhone Handoff feature, which allows users to share a single phone number across two devices.
body_html: Telecommunications company Verizon has announced a new monthly fee for the iPhone Handoff feature. Customers who wish to use the functionality, which enables users to share the same phone number across two separate devices, will be charged $10 per month.
